data_output.description: Do not modify data.py or its encoding semantics. Validation examples must remain in the original canonical validation row order. The training command must emit predictions_valid.npz containing exactly two arrays, row_ids and scores; row_ids must identify canonical validation positions in order and scores must be one finite score per row, aligned positionally with row_ids. No labels or ground truth may be written to the artifact.

model_input.description: model.py must expose a pairwise BPR training interface receiving aligned positive and negative feature matrices, with one sampled positive-negative pair per eligible user per training step or batch. It must optimize -log(sigmoid(score_positive - score_negative)) with the existing factorization-machine architecture, user/item IDs, request-context fields, embeddings, learning-rate, L2 regularization, and finite prediction behavior unchanged. trainer must construct pairs only from training rows sharing a user, exclude users lacking at least one positive and one negative, retain deterministic sampling under config seed, use validation predictions solely for the existing training-time proxy and checkpoint selection, and preserve the fixed evaluator protocol.
